enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the body. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Turn the body to the side. Adjust the pillow. Remain asleep. Turn over to the other side. Extend an arm. Pull the sheet back up. Continue lying still on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and washing up with cool water before the heat builds
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Turn the shower tap. Let the water run. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and torso. Rinse the body. Turn the tap off. Reach for the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the rail. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a quick breakfast of toast, fruit and a cold drink
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Take out the fruit. Take out a cold drink. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the toaster plug. Insert the plug into the socket. Place two slices of bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Wait. Open the cupboard door. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the counter. Take out a glass. Place the glass on the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the juice. Pour juice into the glass. Close the refrigerator door. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Sit on the chair. Pick up the toast. Bite the toast. Chew. Pick up the fruit. Bite the fruit. Chew. Pick up the glass. Drink the juice. Put the glass down. Stand up. Carry the plate and glass to the sink. Rinse the plate and glass. Place them in the dishwasher. Wipe the counter with the cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in light work clothes, packing a water bottle and refilling the bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pull up the zip. Fasten the belt. Walk to the bed. Pick up the work bag. Open the bag. Place the water bottle inside the bag. Close the bag. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Place the phone into the pocket. Pick up the keys. Place the keys into the bag. Pick up the bag. Walk to the door. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital early to avoid the worst of the heatwave using public transport or walking
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Close the front door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk along the shaded side of the street. Wait at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand near the door. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement. Open the hospital entrance door. Walk through the corridor. Push the staff room door open. Walk to the locker. Open the locker. Place the bag inside. Close the locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing and treating patients in the rehabilitation ward
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the rehabilitation ward. Pick up the patient file from the desk. Read the notes. Walk to the first patient's bed. Greet the patient. Ask the patient to sit up. Support the patient's arm. Ask the patient to lift the arm. Guide the arm through the range of motion. Ask the patient to bend the knee. Support the leg. Assist the patient to stand. Hold the patient's elbow. Walk beside the patient along the parallel bars. Ask the patient to sit down. Place a cushion behind the patient's back. Pick up the goniometer. Measure the joint angle. Write the measurement in the file. Remove the cushion. Walk to the next patient's bed. Greet the patient. Pick up the resistance band. Hand the band to the patient. Demonstrate the exercise. Correct the patient's posture with the hand. Count the repetitions out loud. Take the band back. Walk to the desk. Type the treatment notes into the computer. Press the mouse button to save the file.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the staff room, eating a packed lunch and rehydrating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take out the lunch box and the water bottle. Close the locker. Sit on the chair at the table. Open the lunch box. Pick up the fork. Pick up food with the fork. Put the food into the mouth. Chew. Swallow. Repeat eating with the fork. Pick up the water bottle. Unscrew the cap. Raise the bottle to the mouth. Drink the water. Screw the cap back on. Put the bottle down. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Close the lunch box. Pick up the lunch box and the bottle. Stand up. Open the locker. Place the items inside. Close the locker. Push the chair back under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy treatment sessions, patient documentation and handover notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the treatment room. Pick up the therapy ball. Place the therapy ball on the mat. Ask the patient to sit on the ball. Support the patient's hips. Guide the patient to rock the pelvis. Take the ball away. Help the patient stand. Walk the patient back to the bed. Adjust the bed height with the handle. Position the pillow under the patient's leg. Pick up the cold pack from the freezer. Wrap it in a towel. Place it on the patient's knee. Walk to the desk. Sit on the chair. Open the file. Type the session notes into the computer. Scroll the page with the mouse. Print the handover sheet. Pick up the printed sheet. Staple the pages. Place the sheet into the folder. Stand up. Walk to the nurse station. Hand the folder to the nurse. Say the handover details out loud.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift, keeping to the shaded route using public transport or walking
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the locker. Open the locker. Take out the bag. Close the locker. Walk out of the ward. Push the hospital entrance door open. Walk along the shaded pavement. Wait at the bus stop. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Walk up the steps to the house. Take the key out of the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Step inside. Close the door behind. Lock the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner and eating it while the range hood clears the kitchen air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board. Place the cut vegetables into a bowl. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Crack the eggs into the bowl. Stir the eggs with the chopsticks. Pour the eggs into the pan. Stir the food with the spatula. Press the range hood button to start the fan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the food. Press the induction cooker button off. Pick up the plate. Slide the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the food. Put the chopsticks down. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Rinse the plate. Place the plate in the dishwasher. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Press the range hood button off. Press the light switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the air-conditioned living room and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Pick up the remote control. Point the remote at the air conditioner. Press the power button. Press the temperature button. Sit down on the sofa. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Place the remote on the cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the legs. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the water bottle from the table. Drink the water. Put the bottle down. Press the volume button on the remote. Put the remote down on the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing clinical notes and reading physiotherapy continuing-education material on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the study. Pull the chair out. Sit on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse. Click the folder icon. Open the clinical notes file. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Read the text on the monitor. Open the browser. Type the search words on the keyboard. Press the enter key. Open the article page. Scroll the article. Pick up the pen. Write notes on the paper. Put the pen down. Click the save button. Press the computer power button off. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk out of the study.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cooling shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Press the light switch on. Press the fan switch on. Turn the shower tap on. Step under the water. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and legs. Rinse the body. Turn the tap off. Reach for the towel. Dry the body. Dry the hair. Hang the towel on the rail. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Press the fan switch off. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet wind-down on the couch, checking the phone and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the couch. Pick up the phone from the table. Press the phone power button. Swipe the screen. Open the message app. Tap the message. Type a reply on the screen. Tap the send button. Open the music app. Tap the play button. Put the phone down on the cushion. Lean back on the couch. Listen to the music. Pick up the phone. Tap the next track button. Put the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the air conditioner. Point the remote at it. Press the temperature button. Walk back to the couch. Sit down. Pick up the phone. Press the phone power button off. Put the phone into the pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed early with the air conditioner on to sleep before another hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Pick up the remote control. Point the remote at the air conditioner. Press the power button. Press the temperature button. Place the remote on the bedside table. Take off the clothes. Put on the sleepwear. Pull back the sheet. Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the body. Reach over to the bedside table. Press the light switch off. Lie on the back. Close eyes. Turn onto the side. Adjust the pillow. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over to the other side. Remain asleep.
